sarah_sales: quick one — running a presales POC, customer insists traffic & keys stay in AWS Wavelength (us-east-1-wl1). They want BYO-KMS for request payload encryption and proof that sub-processors in that path are carrier-only. Any immediate blockers?
ops_oncall: @sarah_sales short answer: we don't currently have a hosted control plane inside Wavelength zones. For Redwood Private / Dedicated we can place inference compute in a VPC that touches Wavelength via customer carrier setup, but there are two gaps: 1) control plane signaling still goes through our control plane region, 2) some telemetry/agent hooks may egress to our ops region unless isolated.
eng_infra: adding detail — compute in wl zones is possible if customer exposes an ENI to the WL zone and we run our runtime there. Need infra ticket to validate driver/kernel compatibility for the specific instance types. Also need to confirm subproc list: carrier partners are often separate legal entities — we can provide attestation but not guaranteed contractual subproc substitution.
privacy_legal: FYI we need to run through Data Processing Addendum (DPA) + subprocessor appendix. If they require carrier-only subprocessor list for network egress, that's a legal exception that will need sign-off. Request: share the exact carrier name and SLA expectations.
sarah_sales: noted. customer carrier is "MegaTel Wireless" per presales call. They asked for a config sample to show routing preference + fallback to region if wl1 capacity not available. Can we share an ops-friendly snippet?
sre_pete: here's a minimal example we can share — preference hint + safe fallback. Tell them fallback is to us-east-1 compute and that we'll include canary routing for POC.

```json
{
  "routing_policy": {
    "preferred_zone": "us-east-1-wl1",
    "fallback_sequence": ["us-east-1", "us-east-2"],
    "require_byo_kms": true,
    "kms_policy_hint": "customer-managed",
    "caching": "local-prefix-disabled"
  }
}
```

sre_pete: important notes — prefix/KV caching disabled in wl zones unless customer sysadmins approve shared disk cache. That avoids cross-zone egress. Also set token-level logging off for the POC to reduce control-plane telemetry.
deploy-bot: NOTE: provision request #PR-9182 created for dedicated wl1 pool validation (ETA 3d).
ops_oncall: next operational asks: 1) customer to confirm carrier peering and ENI details, 2) BYO-KMS endpoint inside their VPC (we need endpoint DNS & ARN), 3) expected QPS and max seq length for perf sizing.
sarah_sales: I'll collect carrier docs and KMS ARN. QPS is small for POC (~5 rps) and short seqs. I'll ping back once I have docs. Thanks everyone :pray:
